item.title: Turnout tracker: How many people have voted in the March 2026 primaries?
item.description: With early voting underway, KXAN is keeping track of how many Texans have voted in the March 3, 2026, primary elections.

item.title: 183 North Mobility Project 'close to completion'; Southbound lanes should open this weekend
item.description: Director of Engineering Mike Sexton told board members that the 183 North Mobility Project is "getting close to completion," though there's still some work to be done.

item.title: AMBER Alert discontinued after missing 12-year-old found, suspect arrested
item.description: Authorities said a suspect connected with a local AMBER Alert was arrested, and a missing 12-year-old was found safe.

item.title: Fire threat jumps Thursday with dry cold front
item.description: Our next cold front arrives tomorrow late in the morning with the main change being a shift in wind direction resulting in a drier north wind. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: Council members to vote on items tackling Austin homeless strategies
item.description: Thursday, Austin City Council is set to vote on expanding Camp Esperanza, a community in east Austin dedicated to helping people transition out of homelessness. The community is part of a strategic plan aimed at supporting homelessness in the city.

item.title: Man accused of harboring a runaway following local AMBER Alert:
item.description: A man was arrested and booked into the Travis County Jail on Wednesday in connection with a local AMBER Alert.

item.title: State Board of Education discusses changes to social studies curriculum
item.description: The Texas State Board of Education is considering making Texas history a prominent part of the social studies curriculum, but some educators and students have concerns about the density of the material and the lack of time to revise it.

item.title: Appellate court reverses ruling that granted new trial in 2020 Maund murder-for-hire
item.description: Erik Charles Maund, a former partner with the Austin-area Maund Automotive Group, and two others were convicted in 2023 for their roles in the kidnapping and murder of Nashville residents Holly Williams and William Lanway.

item.title: Council item could allow Austin Police to cite drivers for noisy vehicles
item.description: City council members on Thursday will consider amending city code to let police officers cite motorists for loud engine noise, especially in residential areas.

item.title: 2026 State of the Union Texas guests included Coast Guard rescue swimmer, 11-year-old flood survivor
item.description: President Donald Trump held his first State of the Union address to Congress (SOTU) of his second term on Tuesday, and in it he spoke briefly about the July 4, 2025 floods in Central Texas.
